column2: The Raven's Child

The Raven came to me in the night. Its feathers shimmered with every colour and none, and its voice was a thousand voices.\n\nIt told me to take up arms, gather the faithful and be their prophet. It told me to march south, to Kislev, and tear the land of the ice witches from the grasp of weak men and their dead gods. It told me the Wastes themselves would open a road for me.
I must go at once!
The Death of [From.GetFirstName]

I have rid the world of [From.GetFirstName], and with [From.GetHerHim] the mad dream of a Black Crusade led by a child. The children and the wretches who flocked to [From.GetHerHis] banner have scattered to the four winds, wailing that the Raven has abandoned them.\n\nPerhaps it has. Or perhaps the Changer of Ways wanted exactly this.

I feared my [GetFromRelation]'s zeal for the Raven God would lead [From.GetHerHim] to an early grave, and so it has. [From.GetFirstName] is gone. The children and wretches who followed [From.GetHerHim] have scattered to the four winds, unable to understand why [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] would let their prophet die with [From.GetHerHis] task undone.\n\nThe Changer of Ways weaves many threads. It seems [From.GetFirstName] was no longer one of them.

[From.GetFirstName] is dead, and with [From.GetHerHim] the dream of a Black Crusade led by a child. The children and wretches who followed [From.GetHerHim] have scattered to the four winds, unable to understand why [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] would let their prophet die with [From.GetHerHis] task undone.\n\nThe Changer of Ways weaves many threads. It seems [From.GetFirstName] was no longer one of them.
Such a short thread, for such a young [From.GetBoyGirl].

[From.GetFirstName] sits in my dungeon, and the Raven's Child is a prophet no more. [From.GetHerHis] followers are already drifting away, muttering that [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] would never let [From.GetHerHis] chosen one be caught so easily.
[From.GetSheHeCap] will stay there until [From.GetSheHe] learns some sense.

[FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has taken [From.GetFirstName] prisoner, and the Raven's Child will lead no one to Kislev. [From.GetHerHis] followers have scattered, wailing that [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] would never let [From.GetHerHis] chosen one fall so easily.\n\nThe Changer of Ways weaves many threads. It seems [From.GetFirstName] was no longer one of them.
Perhaps it is for the best.
The Chosen Child

Something has happened to my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName].

[From.GetSheHeCap] swears the Raven came to [From.GetHerHim] in the night and ordered [From.GetHerHim] to gather the true faithful, become their prophet and lead a Black Crusade against the weak men of Kislev. [From.GetHerHis] eyes have changed colour since. Twice.

Now [From.GetSheHe] demands money, weapons and warriors to show my faith in [From.GetHerHis] holy task, and will not hear a word of reason. [From.GetSheHeCap] means to leave [Root.Capital.GetName] at once.

[From.GetFirstName], a child of [Root.Capital.GetName], has caused quite a stir. [From.GetSheHeCap] forced [From.GetHerHis] way into my hall and announced that the Raven came to [From.GetHerHim] in a dream and ordered [From.GetHerHim] to gather the true faithful of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] and lead a Black Crusade against Kislev.\n\nThe brat finished [From.GetHerHis] sermon by ordering me to provide money, weapons and warriors, in the name of the Changer of Ways.
You will have my full support!
I will send some warriors to guard you.
Take some food for the road.
Of course! I will even find you a boat south.
You are dead to me. Go, and never come back!
Guards! Throw this babbling fool out!
If this is what you want, I will not stop you.
Do as you like. It is no concern of mine.

Word comes from [FromFrom.Capital.GetName] of a [FromFrom.GetBoyGirl] who has dreamed of the Raven. [FromFrom.GetSheHeCap] has proclaimed [FromFrom.GetHerselfHimself] the prophet of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] and called the true faithful to a Black Crusade against the weak men of Kislev.\n\nThousands of runaway children, outcasts and starving wretches already follow [FromFrom.GetHerHim] across the Wastes. [FromFrom.GetSheHeCap] says the Wastes themselves will open a road to the south.
A wild imagination, even for a child.
May [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] show [childrens_crusade_leader.GetHerHim] the road to victory!
Could this child truly speak for the Changer of Ways?

The ragged host of [childrens_crusade_leader.GetFirstName] has reached [Root.Capital.GetName]: a parade of shrieking children, cripples and starvelings that has already stripped the fields bare. As if that were not enough, their small prophet has demanded an audience and informs me that I am to feed and shelter [childrens_crusade_leader.GetHerHis] holy warriors.
Your cause has moved me! I will support you.
Take some supplies and go.
Oh, I know just the place for you to stay...
Warriors! Drive these lunatics out!
We have nothing to spare.

The ragged host of [childrens_crusade_leader.GetFirstName] has reached [Root.Capital.GetName]: a parade of shrieking children, cripples and starvelings that has already stripped the fields bare. Their small prophet has demanded an audience, and informs me that I am to give [childrens_crusade_leader.GetHerHim] warriors and weapons for [childrens_crusade_leader.GetHerHis] holy war.
I will do much more than that!
Very well, you may have some of my warriors.
Ask among my people. Some may follow you.
Do not worry, I know just whom to call...
What sort of joke is this? Warriors!
I have no warriors to waste on a hopeless march.

Ever since the ragged host of [childrens_crusade_leader.GetFirstName] reached [Root.Capital.GetName], [child_outraged_priest.GetTitledFirstName] has done nothing but complain. This Black Crusade is a mockery of the gods, [child_outraged_priest.GetSheHe] says, and I should make an example of its little prophet before more of my people fall for [childrens_crusade_leader.GetHerHis] empty words.
But [childrens_crusade_leader.GetSheHe] is the chosen of the Raven God!
Worry not, [child_outraged_priest.GetFirstName]. These pests will disappear.
I will have them whipped out of [Root.Capital.GetName].
Let us not trouble ourselves with children.

Ever since the ragged host of [childrens_crusade_leader.GetFirstName] reached [Root.Capital.GetName], I have been drawn to the words of its little prophet. At night I dream of a raven with feathers of every colour, and it whispers my name. The Raven God is surely with [childrens_crusade_leader.GetHerHim].
I must go with [childrens_crusade_leader.GetHerHim]!
But war is so frightening!

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] is gone. Swayed by the sermons of [childrens_crusade_leader.GetFirstName], [From.GetSheHe] crept out in the night to join the Raven's Child on the march to Kislev.
Then I will back the march, to keep my [GetFromRelation] alive!
Will I ever see [From.GetHerHim] again?
I have a [GetFromRelation]?
How could [From.GetSheHe] do this to me!
The Wastes Do Not Part

[From.GetFirstName] promised that the shifting lands of the Chaos Wastes would open a road before [From.GetHerHis] host. The Raven did not keep that promise. Now the great ragged army of children and wretches wanders lost in the Far Wastes, beneath the shadow of the Inevitable City.\n\nThe weakest have already lost their faith, or their lives. Yet [From.GetFirstName] remains certain, and every day new hopeless souls join [From.GetHerHim].
They need more warriors to guard them.
I will send what I can to help them on their way.
I can spare some food to keep them alive.
I will make a sacrifice in their name.
They can still give up their lost cause.
The Broken Lands

The Children's host forced its way out of the Far Wastes at last, only for the ground itself to shift beneath them and hurl them into the Broken Lands. Word from the march is scarce, but rumour says many now doubt [From.GetFirstName]. Even the Wastes, it seems, will not bend to [From.GetHerHis] will.\n\nAnd still this unlikely horde of children and wretches marches south.
They must need supplies!
I will declare my support again, to shore up [From.GetFirstName]'s authority.
I will send letters to the local warlords to find them a better road.
I can only hope they endure.
Perhaps they were never part of the plans of the Changer of Ways.
The Eastern Steppes

Against every hardship, and every attempt to undermine [From.GetHerHis] leadership, [From.GetFirstName] has led [From.GetHerHis] host to the Eastern Steppes. With the lands of Kislev at last within reach, the faith of the Black Crusaders burns hotter than ever. Their prophet swears that the weak men of the south will throw open their gates to the chosen of the Raven.

Against every hardship, and every attempt to undermine [From.GetHerHis] leadership, [From.GetFirstName] has led [From.GetHerHis] host to the Eastern Steppes. Kislev is within reach at last.\n\n[From.GetFirstName] has sent me a message, thanking me for my support and asking for any further help I can give in the fight ahead. With my aid and the blessing of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], [From.GetSheHe] is certain of victory over the weak men of the south and their dead gods.
When the time comes, I will fight beside you!
I will set aside more for your war.
I can only offer a sacrifice in your name.
There is little else I can do.
How are they still alive?
Zanbaijin

Guided by a vision of the Raven across the steppes, the host of [From.GetFirstName] has reached Zanbaijin, on the very edge of Kislev. Word of the Black Crusade has run ahead of it. [From.GetFirstName] promised that the southerners would open their gates to the chosen of the Raven. Instead, the boyars are mustering their winged lancers and the Tzar's streltsi, eager to cut down the children before they cross the Lynsk.\n\nThe world will soon see whether [From.GetFirstName] is truly blessed.

Guided by a vision of the Raven across the steppes, the host of [From.GetFirstName] has reached Zanbaijin, on the very edge of Kislev. Word of the Black Crusade has run ahead of it. [From.GetFirstName] promised that the southerners would open their gates to the chosen of the Raven. Instead, the boyars are mustering their winged lancers and the Tzar's streltsi, eager to cut down the children before they cross the Lynsk.\n\nThe world will soon see whether [From.GetFirstName] is truly blessed, or whether I was a fool to put my trust in a child.
[From.GetSheHeCap] does not stand alone!
[From.GetFirstName] will not fight this war alone!
A worthy sacrifice will win [From.GetHerHim] favour!
Those poor, foolish souls...

Whatever drove so many to follow [From.GetFirstName] has blown away like smoke. The Raven's host is no more, its army scattered, its backers dead or gone.\n\n[From.GetFirstName], still convinced [From.GetSheHe] is the messenger of the Raven, is mocked by all as a raving lunatic who spends [From.GetHerHis] days shrieking at strangers about the end of all things.
And [From.GetSheHe] showed such promise...
It did not go as planned, then.

Before the real armies of Kislev, the Raven's host shattered into a thousand weeping pieces. Without captains, weapons or true warriors, [From.GetFirstName] could not stand. [From.GetSheHeCap] led [From.GetHerHis] followers across the whole of the Chaos Wastes, and the vision of the Raven will still go unfulfilled.\n\nAbandoned by nearly all, the [From.GetBoyGirl] has vanished: killed, captured, or worse.
A sad but certain end.

A mad child, plainly touched by [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName], has reached our borders at the head of a vast rabble of children and starving wretches, claiming it is [From.GetHerHis] holy duty to conquer Kislev for [From.GetHerHis] god.\n\nThe number of fools who believe the [From.GetBoyGirl] is worrying. The idea that a mob of starvelings could beat a [Root.Religion.GetName] army in the field is laughable.
We will cut them down like sheep.

Before the real armies of Kislev, the Raven's host shattered into a thousand weeping pieces. Without captains, weapons or true warriors, [From.GetFirstName] could not stand, and the vision of the Raven will go unfulfilled.\n\nThe southerners slaughtered every grown man and woman who followed [From.GetHerHim]. The children were taken, or worse.
A shameful end, and a predictable one.

As expected, the fools who trusted their lives to a child were cut down by the winged lancers in a single afternoon. They had no captains, no warriors, no armour, no siege engines, no food. That they crossed the Wastes at all is a wonder. Why the Ruinous Powers brought them so far only to throw them away, only the Ice Witches might say.\n\nThe few surviving children have been taken. They will be purified, or purged. There is no room in Kislev for the touch of Chaos.
There could be no other end to such a pathetic war.

Against all reason, the children of the Raven God have won! Hosts of daemons poured out of the air above the battlefield, slaughtering the panicked Kislevites, smashing their walls to dust, rusting their sabres in their hands and melting the eyes from their heads.\n\nA child now rules a new domain, chosen of the Raven God. Only time will tell how long the favour of the Changer of Ways will last.
I can deny it no longer: [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] is with [From.GetHerHim]!
This is impossible!

Against all reason, the children of the Raven God have won! Hosts of daemons poured out of the air above the battlefield, slaughtering the panicked Kislevites, smashing their walls to dust, rusting their sabres in their hands and melting the eyes from their heads.\n\nA child now rules a new domain in the south, chosen of the Raven God. Only time will tell how long the favour of the Changer of Ways will last.
Let [From.GetHerHis] reign be long and glorious!
I always believed in [From.GetHerHim]!
[Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] was with [From.GetHerHim].
Wha-? How...?
It truly was all part of a greater plan...
